tool_args.rationale: Ten rows are available after the prior fine-trajectory acquisition, with endpoint-matched histories producing different outcomes and coupled transient-lag signatures. Fit the archived four-parameter memory ODE numerically from these rows, deriving the initial memory state from each raw prefix and integrating both states with RK4. The previous execution error was an interface issue (predict was called without fitted parameters); this implementation stores the fitted vector during fit so fresh predictions can use it.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The stated target horizon is short (0.45), and observations show coupled transient/history dependence rather than a long-horizon reversal.
